description:
The entry we’re documenting is a reference to external content. Specifically, it points to an article that should be fetched using the oEmbed service.  

The article’s unique identifier is **a1b2c3d4e5**, and it can be retrieved from the provider at the following URL: https://api.example.com/articles/a1b2c3d4e5.
